text.tspan: Part B: add one piece at a time; each missing piece fails differently
r1 gets the packets but isn't
r1 forwards, but has no route
h2 has no route back to 10.0.1.0/24
h2 replies via r2, but r2 has no
route back; r2 tells h2, not h1
No error at all = a silent drop or a missing route back: capture on the far end and ask "does it know how to get back to me?"
